audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and packet chart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Zed/Zed/Zed/Zed.
audit.why: Levels 1-3 are genuinely even — Blooming Burst pokes, Tangle-Barbs threatens the dash. From 4 onward Zed's full W-E-Q out-damages her whenever the 12-10s root is down.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side moved to Zed as one group; rows 0-2 left as Skill because they already agree with win[0..2].

audit.why: Zed spikes at 4-6 and first item; Neeko's spike is Pop Blossom at 120/105/90 chained off a landed Tangle-Barbs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Tangle-Barbs 'the root' with no cooldown, and never stated that Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.why: Riot's R text says the preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised — that is the actual danger behind the level 6 all-in, and it was unstated.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and the disguise clause written into breakdown.cooldowns; the root-into-knockup chain stated in breakdown.trading and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twelve fields called Neeko 'he/his/him'; dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim; dosFull[1].t promised a 'post-combo silence' that exists nowhere in either kit.
audit.why: Neeko is female, and neither champion has a silence.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected, bleed replaced with kit-grounded bodies, and the phantom silence title replaced with her real root window.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Living Shadow (swap) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — the root sets up her whole burst, so sidestep it behind minions and step up right after. - Pop Blossom is 120s at rank 1, and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1.
